replies.author: @jonadabtheunsightly
replies.text: The donut thing is commonly misunderstood.  Because, yes, it's technically true that the world is topologically equivalent to a type of donut, but it's not the stereotypical toroidal donut like you show in your video.  Sorry, but that's just not accurate.  In fact, the world is topologically equivalent to a Berliner, a type of German jelly donut.  That's what the famous quote is about: we are all of us equally citizens of the world, regardless of which country we are from.  History teachers usually don't care about algebraic topology (if they even studied it at all; some history programs don't even require it), so they hardly ever bother to explain Kennedy's speech properly.  But now at least *you* know.  HTH.HAND.
